verdict.rationale: AMD officially supports Windows 11, RHEL and Ubuntu on this chip and ships a deep first-party AI tooling stack. That stack includes ONNX Runtime with the Vitis AI EP, Quark quantization, AI Analyzer, xrt-smi, Lemonade SDK and Linux NPU guides, and community users report running llama.cpp workloads on it. However, the evidence covers the AI/NPU software stack rather than the architecture as a general compile target, and nothing addresses compiler maturity or CPU-level optimization guidance. Missing for 10: evidence of mature compiler support (GCC/LLVM/AOCC tuning for this chip), official CPU/architecture optimization guides, and independent corroboration that the OS/toolchain ecosystem treats it as tier one.
